claims.text: A 68-year-old woman with hypertension and diabetes mellitus reportedly had a cerebrovascular event of undocumented subtype about five years before presentation, leaving right-sided hemiparesis. Recurrent focal motor seizures evolving to bilateral tonic-clonic seizures began about two years later, increasing from 1-2 to 3-4 per year, with a recent flurry and new right-sided epilepsia partialis continua.
